# Lab 21.3: Assignments by Job Type

## What We Are Going to Do
Send different job types (queries, loads, ML, background work) to different reservations, and force one project back to on-demand.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create two small reservations.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --reservation --location=US --edition=STANDARD --slots=0 --autoscale_max_slots=50 lab-bi
bq mk --reservation --location=US --edition=ENTERPRISE --slots=0 --autoscale_max_slots=50 lab-etl</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Assign by job type.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --reservation_assignment --reservation_id=$PROJECT_ID:US.lab-bi \
  --job_type=QUERY --assignee_type=PROJECT --assignee_id=$PROJECT_ID
bq mk --reservation_assignment --reservation_id=$PROJECT_ID:US.lab-etl \
  --job_type=PIPELINE --assignee_type=PROJECT --assignee_id=$PROJECT_ID
bq ls --reservation_assignment --location=US</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   `PIPELINE` covers load, export and copy jobs. Other job types are `ML_EXTERNAL` (AutoML, Vertex training), `BACKGROUND` (for example, autonomous embeddings and index builds) and `CONTINUOUS`.

3. **[CLI] Run one of each and check.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq load --source_format=PARQUET --replace lab20.names_load "gs://$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs/formats/parquet/names-*"
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab20.names_load'
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT job_type, reservation_id FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_USER ORDER BY creation_time DESC LIMIT 2'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Use the `none` reservation.** In **Workload management → Assignments**, an assignment to the special `none` reservation makes a project use on-demand pricing even when a parent folder has a reservation.

5. **[CLI] Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">for A in $(bq ls --reservation_assignment --location=US --format=json | python3 -c "import sys,json;[print(a['name']) for a in json.load(sys.stdin)]"); do bq rm --reservation_assignment $A; done
bq rm --reservation --location=US lab-bi
bq rm --reservation --location=US lab-etl</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| QUERY | Interactive and batch queries |
| PIPELINE | Load, export, copy |
| Hierarchy | Org → folder → project, closest wins |
| `none` | Opt a project out to on-demand |
